viable ordinary route would fit a linear model using endpoint readings (low, high) to estimate the true value and check if the reading falls within a defined [lower, upper] band. This approach assumes the sensor behavior is linear and relies on endpoint calibration. However, it lacks validation of the midpoint, which may be affected by drift. Our route introduces an independent midpoint check (mid) to verify the linearity assumption: if the midpoint deviates from the expected (low+high)/2 by more than maxResidual, it signals potential sensor drift. This independent check strengthens the distinction between true defects and sensor drift, ensuring robustness against non-linear or drifting behavior.
